editor.premise: A road-trip stop becomes a timed challenge to explore the surprising services inside an enormous truck stop.

chapters.name: Arrival and countdown
chapters.purpose: Preview the possibilities, arrive, and start the timed visit.

chapters.name: Challenge briefing
chapters.purpose: Explain the trip context and establish the site's enormous scale.

chapters.name: Exploring amenities
chapters.purpose: Turn the promised variety into a succession of discoveries.

chapters.name: Gym visit
chapters.purpose: Pause the walking tour to actually use one unexpected facility.

chapters.name: More services
chapters.purpose: Resume exploration and let a service-counter exchange play out.

chapters.name: Truck accessories
chapters.purpose: Move downstairs and begin another retail discovery.

captions.note: Opening titles and countdowns establish stakes; occasional emphasis text and small dialogue subtitles punctuate speech. Most visible signage belongs to the location, not added captions.

editor.notes: Keep previews brisk, then slow down for orientation, discoveries, and real exchanges. Alternate face-led explanations with pointing-hand evidence. Save wider, longer views for scale; use brief corridors to preserve geography without showing every step.
